title: Local Administrator Password Solution (Windows LAPS) is Not Configured
description: Windows LAPS automatically manages and rotates the password of a local administrator account, preventing pass-the-hash lateral movement.
expected: LAPS BackupDirectory configured (Active Directory or Azure AD)
impact: Static, shared local administrator passwords across multiple endpoints enable catastrophic lateral movement upon compromise of a single host.
remediation_guidance: Configure Windows LAPS via Group Policy or Intune: Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > System > LAPS.
